title: Your First Weekend at Carnegie Mellon University, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your arrival at CMU with this sequence of essential orientation traditions, campus landmarks, and local Pittsburgh staples accessible with your new student ID.

cards.title: Check In at Welcome Plaza
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Arrival
cards.notes: Visit the plaza between noon and 4 p.m. to check in, grab your official Class of 2030+ t-shirt, and take your first photos as a Tartan.
cards.short_summary: The primary check-in hub for new students and families during move-in weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Plaza features check-in, photo opportunities, and class t-shirt distribution from noon to 4 p.m. on move-in day.
cards.source_title: Daily Schedule Overview - First-Year Orientation - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Located near the East Campus Garage and Cohon University Center during orientation.

cards.title: Browse the Resource Expo
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon
cards.notes: Meet representatives from campus departments to ask questions about student services and collect useful university literature.
cards.short_summary: An informational fair showcasing campus resources and student support departments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tartan Resource Expo runs from 2 to 4:30 p.m. on move-in Saturday for new students.
cards.source_title: Daily Schedule Overview - First-Year Orientation - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Typically held in the Cohon University Center or adjacent outdoor spaces.

cards.title: Visit the Most Painted Object
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening
cards.notes: Walk by this campus landmark on The Cut; it is a student-only bulletin board that must be painted between midnight and sunrise.
cards.short_summary: A central campus landmark and tradition where students paint messages and stand guard.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fence is a long-standing CMU tradition where students paint messages and must guard it to prevent others from repainting.
cards.source_title: A Layered History - CMU125 - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Located in the center of 'The Cut' lawn; accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Attend the President's Welcome
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning
cards.notes: Join your fellow first-years to hear from the University President as you officially begin your academic journey at CMU.
cards.short_summary: The formal university welcome address for incoming students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: The President's Welcome is a key orientation event for first-year students and families held on Sunday morning.
cards.source_title: Orientation Schedule - First-Year Orientation - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Location varies by year; check the CMU Events App for the specific venue.

cards.title: Compete in the Carnegie Cup
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon
cards.notes: Participate in this orientation tradition that brings residence halls together for friendly competition and community building.
cards.short_summary: A residence hall-based competition held during the first-year orientation week.
cards.evidence_claim: The Carnegie Cup is an orientation tradition that brings the residence hall communities together.
cards.access_notes: Events typically held at Gesling Stadium or the East Campus athletic fields.

cards.title: Explore Phipps Conservatory
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Walk
cards.notes: Use your CMU ID for free admission to these historic glasshouses and botanical gardens located right next to campus.
cards.short_summary: A world-class botanical garden offering free entry to CMU students via the Arts Pass.
cards.evidence_claim: CMU students receive free access to Phipps Conservatory and Botanical Gardens with their university ID.
cards.source_title: Arts Pass - Student Affairs - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; students must present a valid CMU ID at the admissions desk.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Prep
cards.notes: Visit the university's main library to scout out study spaces; it stays open until 3 a.m. on most nights for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary library for arts, humanities, and social sciences at Carnegie Mellon.
cards.evidence_claim: Hunt Library is open until 3 a.m. on Saturdays and Sundays during the academic term.
cards.access_notes: A valid CMU ID is required to enter the building after 7 p.m.

cards.title: Hike Panther Hollow
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Refresh
cards.notes: Explore the 456-acre park adjacent to campus; the Panther Hollow trails offer a wooded escape from the city environment.
cards.short_summary: A large urban park bordering campus featuring extensive hiking and running trails.
cards.evidence_claim: Schenley Park is a 456-acre green space popular with CMU students for decompression and outdoor activity.
cards.source_title: Things to do in Pittsburgh - Office of International Education - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Accessible from Frew Street or behind the Phipps Conservatory.

cards.title: Hear the Kiltie Band
cards.subtitle: Monday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Catch the 'Band Without Pants' at their first rehearsal of the semester at 5:30 p.m. in the CUC Studio Theater.
cards.short_summary: CMU's spirited marching band known for wearing kilts and performing at campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kiltie Band's first rehearsal is typically held on the first day of classes at 5:30 p.m. in the CUC Studio Theater.
cards.source_title: The Kiltie Band - Carnegie Mellon University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Rehearsals are open to the campus community; no audition is required to join.

cards.title: Grab Lunch at Legacy Plaza
cards.subtitle: Monday Lunch Break
cards.notes: Visit the campus food truck for a quick meal; it often features rotating local Pittsburgh restaurants and accepts meal blocks.
cards.short_summary: A student-led food truck program located in Legacy Plaza featuring local cuisine.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tartan Express food truck operates at Legacy Plaza and accepts meal blocks, FLEX, and credit cards.
cards.source_title: Tartan Food Truck Takeover Returns - Dining Services - Carnegie Mellon University
cards.access_notes: Located at Legacy Plaza; hours are typically 10:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. during the week.
